targets: N64, passes 1/2/4, ascending/descending, three independent role seeds per configuration; original polar generation law theta=.15 Normal, phi=Uniform[0,2pi), phase=0
cases: 18 planted references; each target near truth polar perturbations 0.001 and 0.03 in all coordinates, plus original cold start; 54 starts, 108 A/B fits
initialization: B converts the entire A initial matrix exactly; perturbations declared in polar coordinates, actual initial matrix error recorded; fit seed namespace independent of generation
accounting: A/B share nominal solver schedule, NOT a hard identical evaluation cap; actual closure/gradient counts recorded. Paired traces also compared at minimum common evaluation count; runtimes measured. Each closure includes one dense materialization, objective and backward.
selection: minimum native complex squared Frobenius/N, step zero included; no alignment, BER, Q or receiver selection
gates: A: all 36 near-truth cases below threshold. B: all 18 cold cases below threshold, descriptive reliability limited to this suite. Pilot only if both pass.
conditional_method: If A and B fail, diagnose Adam excursion and stopping. At most one additional solver, frozen amendment before execution, no additional targets/restarts.
diagnostics: central FD h=1e-6 selected parameters N8/N64 shallow/deep/identity/near-identity/complex/representative checkpoints; abs 2e-8 or relative 2e-4 for |g|>1e-7. independent explicit dense gates; N8 SVD only; N64 directional JVP norms, no dense N64 Jacobian
stop: No training, BER, remote jobs, architecture/topology expansion or Stage5B-B. Every failed run retained. Numerical exceptions recorded. No unplanned budget extensions.
